'''Power fusion crystal chips''' were used to regulate [[Fusion generator/Legends|fusion generators]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] a shipment of these chips belonging to the [[Notsub Shipping Company]] Corporation was lost in the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] desert, and Notsub offered a 5,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] finders fee for its recovery.<ref name="SR" />
